name: Party Management Open API
title: Party Management Open API
summary: The Party Management Open API provides endpoints for managing parties with a relationship to the enterprise, like a consumer, account, or contact. Use this API to create, update, and retrieve data from the Consumer [csm_consumer], Account [customer_account], and Contact [customer_contact] tables.
overview:
The Party Management Open API is a ServiceNow® implementation of the TM Forum Party Management API REST specification. This implementation is based on the TMF632 Party Management API Conformance Profile v5.0.0 – TM Forum, June 2025. The Party Management Open API is conformance certified by TM Forum.

Accessing the API

This API is provided within the sn_tmf_api namespace. The calling user must have the sn_tmf_api.party_integrator role. The Customer Service Base Entities (com.snc.cs_base) plugin is required, particularly for all GET operations.

API versions

ServiceNow® supports two versions of Party Management Open API. See related method documentation based on the version you are working with:
  • Party Management Open API v1
  • Party Management Open API v2

The following table summarizes the changes to the Party Management API between v1 and v2. Quickly review how the record type is determined and which values are accepted for contact medium types.

Change v1 v2
Party type The root-level partyOrPartyRole object determines whether the request creates an Account, Consumer, or Contact record. The root-level @type field is optional. The partyOrPartyRole object is removed from the root level of requests and responses. The root-level @type field is required and determines the record type.

Valid values:

  • Account: Creates an Account record.
  • Consumer: Creates a Consumer record.
  • Contact: Creates a Contact record.
Contact medium type contactMedium.mediumType contactMedium.contactType

The accepted values are the same as in v1: email, mobilePhone, businessPhone, homePhone, and postalAddress.

Migrating requests from v1 to v2

  1. If your integration specifies v1 in the endpoint path, change it to v2, or remove the version to use the default.
  2. Remove the root-level partyOrPartyRole object from the request body.
  3. In POST requests, add the root-level @type field and set it to Account, Consumer, or Contact. This field is optional in v1 but required in v2.
  4. In each contactMedium object, rename mediumType to contactType. Keep the existing values.
